criteria.requirement: Fix html5_parse_legacy_color to strip only ASCII space, TAB, LF, FF and CR, leaving NBSP, vertical tab and other Unicode whitespace for the existing legacy replacement/padding algorithm. Preserve named colors, short hex, BMP/non-BMP handling, 128-character truncation, transparent rejection and the separate strict HTML simple-color contract. NBSP-red-NBSP must produce (0,237,0), not silently become red. Whitespace-only input follows the existing legacy padding path. This is a real parser repair, not a generic trim helper.
